description: This file defines the ResetPasswordDao class, which interacts with the database to handle reset password requests including creation, retrieval, and updating request logs.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for managing reset password request records in the database.

methods.name: saveResetPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists a ResetPasswordRequest object to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByEmail
methods.description: Fetches the most recent ResetPasswordRequest for a given email.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ResetPasswordRequest based on the reset code.

methods.name: updateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of reset password requests associated with the given email.
